question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. T has an exam on Friday. Exactly 3 people have an exam between P and U, neither of whom has on exam on Sunday. S has an exam immediately after Q. V has an exam immediately before U. How many people have an exam after S?
solution:
Given: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) T has an exam on Friday.

2) Exactly 3 people have an exam between P and U, neither of whom has an exam on Sunday.

3) V has an exam immediately before U.

Thus, People after S (Wednesday) → Thursday (V), Friday (T), Saturday (U), Sunday (empty) → 3 people have exams after S.

Hence, the correct answer is **3** (Option 1).
